data.title: The Legitimate Heir Doesn’T Want Their Love
data.description:
The capital’s biggest scandal—
The real young master of the Kang family had been thrown away to the countryside for seventeen years while the fake heir, Jen, lived in luxury.
When Kim Taehyung finally returned, no one welcomed him.
“We can’t embarrass Jen,” the Kang family said coldly. “To the public, you’re only an adopted son.”
His fiancé sneered, “My future partner can only be Jen.”
Taehyung simply replied,
“It doesn’t matter.”
No one knew the quiet countryside Ore held a terrifying secret—
Since childhood, he had been able to swap souls with a mysterious rich young master.
While others mocked him as uncultured, Taehyung had already mastered piano, etiquette, academics, and high society through years of soul switching.
Then, at a banquet, an untouchable Enigma heir walked straight toward him before the shocked crowd.
“Be mine,” the man said arrogantly. “You’re beautiful enough for me to overlook your background.”
Taehyung smiled lightly.
“I suddenly miss my countryside parents.”
